release_notes_id: Pengerasan keamanan kriptografi biometrik AndroidKeyStore (AES-GCM), isolasi kredensial tanpa prefill sandi di layar login, pengawas koneksi SSE anti-gantung (watchdog 65 detik + silent re-auth otomatis saat 401), serta pemecahan modul Pipeline & Kontak agar navigasi lebih responsif.
release_notes_en: Hardware-backed AndroidKeyStore (AES-GCM) biometric cryptographic binding, credential isolation without plaintext password prefill on login, resilient SSE watchdog (65s timeout + automatic silent re-auth on 401), and modularized Pipeline & Contacts screens for smoother responsiveness.
